title: Rolling priority heatmap for cross-functional capacity trading
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Context: Mid-cycle we repeatedly face ad-hoc reassignments and emergency scope cuts that create churn for engineering and slow down key initiatives. We lack a lightweight, data-driven surface that lets PMs, Eng leads, and Product Ops visualize current role-level capacity and negotiate short-term trades using a shared priority signal.

Proposal: Build a "rolling priority heatmap" MVP in the Console (and a mirrored Google Sheet prototype) that shows:
  - prioritized initiatives (OKR/initiative mapping) with composite priority score (impact * urgency * visibility).
  - role-level availability (engineers, infra SRE, ML infra, designer capacity) over a rolling 4-week window.
  - heatmap cells colored by mismatch (overallocated, balanced, underallocated).
  - suggested trades: one-click proposals such as "loan 1 backend SWE for 2 weeks" or "pause non-critical infra tasks" which populate a trade card for manual approval.

Algorithm notes (MVP):
  - Composite priority score = weighted sum of OKR alignment (0-10), customer severity (0-10), delivery risk (0-10). PMs provide weights at the project level.
  - Capacity model uses current cycle assignments (from project tracker) + availability adjustments (vacation/known blockers). For pilot we'll ingest a weekly CSV from People Tracker; longer term hook to HRIS and staffing API.
  - Trade suggestions: greedy algorithm that minimizes priority-weighted delay subject to role constraints.

Acceptance criteria (see field below) and rollout: prototype in Sheets + Confluence PRD -> small pilot with Growth, Platform, and Console teams -> integrate into Console as a read-only heatmap first -> enable proposal cards in next iteration.

Tradeoffs and decisions:
  - Privacy: we will not expose individual contributor-level data in Console MVP; heatmap is role-aggregated. (Design decision 2025-02-18)
  - Scope: MVP intentionally excludes automated rebalancing; approvals remain manual to preserve manager control.
  - Data fidelity: initial CSV ingestion means snapshots may lag; commit to weekly refresh for pilot.

Success metrics (pilot):
  - Reduce number of ad-hoc mid-cycle reassignments flagged in ops board by 30% in pilot teams.
  - Mean time to decision on emergency scope cut < 48 hours for pilot teams.
  - PM/Eng satisfaction score >= 4/5 in pilot survey.

Longer term: integrate with capacity API, show cost/unit impact (tokens/infra spend) and add automated canaries that surface risk if a trade would breach SLA.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype heatmap populated from weekly CSV exists (Sheets link) and matches manual audit of assignments
Console read-only heatmap UI available to pilot teams with role-aggregated data
Trade proposal card can be created, saved, and emailed to stakeholders for approval
Pilot with Growth, Platform, and Console completes and PM/Eng pilot survey collected
Metrics dashboard created: number of trades proposed, time-to-decision, mid-cycle reassignments avoided

2025-02-21 - Diego Ramirez (PM): Feedback: priority weights should default to OKR alignment 50%, customer severity 30%, delivery risk 20%. Adjustable per initiative. Added to PRD.

2025-03-01 - Design (DES-9901): Reviewed color palette and accessibility for heatmap. Updated contrast and added text labels to each cell. Expected assets in Figma by 2025-03-04.

2025-03-03 - Luca Mendes: Implemented backend stub that consumes CSV and returns role-level availability. Tested against sample sheet; mismatch logic working for pilot teams. Preparing demo for pilot kickoff 2025-03-06.
